source.notes: Actual per-key resolver stacks resolve CONTROL_SECONDARY_BACKGROUND_ACTIVE in useButtonPillStyles/PillWrapper. Genuine Design.Button secondary variant at standard md size; inert action; real held pointer. Fixed captions are not token evidence.

privacy.notes: Full images show only generic controls and labels; no personal identity, account fields, messages or media.

visual.notes: Full after and focused comparison inspected individually. Only secondary pressed fill changes. Text remains white; other buttons remain at resting appearance. Complete controls, no clipping or rendering artefacts.

annotation.notes: Gold outline encloses the complete secondary button without covering changed pixels. Both panels use identical crop at original scale. Description identifies the pressed fill.

unrelatedComponents.notes: Full-frame effect of 99113 pixels confined to the secondary control. Zero stability/restoration difference, and final release matches pre-press resting PNG exactly. All other controls and system chrome unchanged.

description.notes: Colours the secondary button fill while it is held down.

scope: Genuine native Button fixture, secondary held state only; not stock Settings content.
